match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett catches the closing elevator doors with her shoulder. Framing: medium wide, eye level, The narrow hallway leads into the elevator, with Scarlett entering on the left and the closing doors framing the tired florist, courier, and mirrored interior. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett bursts into the hallway with her coat over one arm and the lipstick in hand as the elevator doors begin closing. Camera, as one or two arrows: truck, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. Tired florist, Unspecified, 40s, A tired-looking adult of average height and medium, Muted work shirt beneath a weathered florist's apron. Courier, Unspecified, 20s-40s, An adult courier of average height, Dark delivery jacket, durable trousers, comfortable work shoes. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
